Title: [VCST-5281] xProfile — Organization.myStatusInOrganization Always Reflects the CALLING User's Own Status, Never an Inspected Contact's
Preconditions: Runner-native. Schema (live-verified 2026-07-29): Organization.myStatusInOrganization: String takes NO arguments — it is resolved purely from the caller's own JWT/membership context, matching the org-context-is-JWT-only pattern already confirmed for rolesInOrganization/isLockedInOrganization (ORGROLE-016). Two different callers querying the SAME organization must each see only their OWN status, confirming there is no hidden way to inspect another member's status through this field.

Failure_Signals: either query's myStatusInOrganization value differs from what that SAME caller's own membership record shows (field resolving from the wrong identity); the field accepts an argument that lets one caller read another member's status (would reopen the cross-org spoofing concern BL-CROSS-013 already guards against for rolesInOrganization/isLockedInOrganization)
